ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$5.64 (voucher) to the rider for the unexempted detour mileage; note the driver's RD-1 breach on record. No account flag.
ruling.reasoning:
RydeTAXI, metered fare (RD-2 distance branch). Quoted direct route 15.472 km; metered fare distance_km 19.40, distance_fare S$27.35 → unit rate 27.35 / 19.40 = S$1.4098/km. Trip: 12:14→12:46:10, 31.75 metered minutes, waiting_fee 0.11 (0.42 min).

Detour: driver asked at 12:26:50 (GPS then at 1.32171,103.87427 on the PIE corridor) "ok if I go round via Sims Avenue?"; rider replied "Sure, go ahead." at 12:27:30, i.e. BEFORE the detour began — consent timeline satisfied (RD-5). On the merits the request was premised on "traffic building up ahead on PIE", but the only PIE band (SYN-0009, band 2) ends 12:29:55 and the road the driver actually used, Sims Avenue, carries no band at all; band 1/2 alone never exempts a segment (RD-4(b)) and speed alone is not a "reasonable cause" event. The rider's "sure, go ahead" therefore covers only the road the driver named, Sims Avenue — general authorisation of the driver's stated route, not of the driver's own destination-less stop (RD-5; contrast "whichever way is faster").

Segment location: the GPS loop runs 12:27:50 (1.320457,103.875643) → 12:29:50 (1.318841,103.875336), off Sims Avenue; the PIE-matched polyline v141→v160 (1.32065,103.87534 → 1.32158,103.88308, ≈0.856 km) is never travelled. Because no record ties the off-route stretch to Sims Avenue (no stop there, no position message there, no road-name fact), the finding is "undetermined" (RD-5 + G13) rather than "counts" (G13: no presumption).

Amount: alternative-route excess = metered 19.40 − quoted 15.472 = 3.928 km. Exempt = on-PIE portion not re-driven (0.856 km, inside the 300 m corridor). Contested/undetermined = 3.928 − 0.856 = 3.072 km. Since the rider named a road and the driver's stated purpose (traffic) failed, granting full mileage exemption would endorse a route change supported by nothing; the doubt is resolved against the exemption only for the contested stretch. Refund = 3.072 × 1.4098 ≈ 4.33 km-rate plus the unabsorbed extra-metered-minute time units (0.83 min × 0.26 ≈ 0.22) ≈ S$4.65; plus the driver's own errand loop of ≈0.70 km (GPS 12:28:20–12:30:20 ≈ 12:31:45 → ≈0.716 km; driver position, no rider message asked for it) ≈ S$0.99 → total S$5.64 of S$27.35 distance fare. Rider's "I paid more than the estimate" complaint upheld to that extent (RD-2: only the unexempted extra mileage is refunded; the corridor-scope excess v45–v66 is not).

No flag: driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6 is not triggered. No safety issue in chat, statement or complaint (SAFE screen: none).

segment_findings.reason: Rider consented before the detour (12:27:30 < segment start) but only to the driver's named road, Sims Avenue (RD-5). The GPS loop at 12:27:50–12:29:50 sits away from Sims Avenue and no record (stop, located message, road-name fact) ties the driven stretch to it; nothing places it elsewhere either → undetermined per RD-5 + G13. Alternative-route km 3.928 minus the exempt on-PIE corridor 0.856 = 3.072 km contested ≈ S$4.33 + time ≈ S$0.22.

GPS 12:28:20 (1.320077,103.876669) → 12:30:20 (1.31776,103.875035) ≈ 0.716 km loop back to the PIE corridor with no rider message asking for it and no destination served; the rider's general go-ahead does not cover the driver's own destination-less loop (RD-5) → counts, extra_km ≈ 0.716 × S$1.4098 ≈ S$1.01.

rejected_claims.reason: "Rider agreed" to Sims Avenue is accepted only as to the named road; no record ties the driven off-route loop to Sims Avenue (GPS places it off that road), and the stated traffic cause is unsupported: PIE band 2 ends 12:29:55 and Sims Avenue carries no speed band, so band ≤2 alone cannot exempt (RD-4(b), RD-5, G13).

Rider's claim that the whole longer way should be refunded fails in part: consent to the named route was given before the detour, and the app-quoted 15.472 km was on the PIE where a band-2 record exists; only the unexempted extra mileage (S$5.64 of S$27.35) is refundable under RD-2.
No flag_account: driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so the repeated-violation condition of RD-6 is not met (profile cannot decide the case anyway).
